messages:
Maya: Proposal: run a short A/B on followup routing after the June launch — Templates arm vs Credits arm. Goal: lift 7d activation from ~11% to >=16% and reduce time-to-first-success.
Eli: Good. What's the creative difference exactly?
Maya: Templates arm = 4 curated prompts + 'Try this' CTA; 50 credits. Credits arm = 150 credits + minimal nudges. Both get a 7-day expiry.
Rae: Ops check: per-user caps and fraud rules? We should cap credits per IP and add a hold if fraud_score > 0.75.
Maya: Agree. Will set per-IP soft cap and fallback 30 credits for flagged users.
Eli: Tracking: add ?utm_source=launch_ab and header X-Exp: launch_ab_template|credit. Tag billing events with experiment:launch_ab.
ops-bot: Flag `launch_ab_routing` ready 2026-06-10T08:00:00Z. Monitor metrics: `launch_ab_activation_template`, `launch_ab_activation_credit`.
Rae: I'll add a Console card: arm comparison (activation %, median time-to-first-success, cost-per-activation). Also surface fraud reclaim count.
Maya: I'll draft the followup email copy and the prompt snippets. Quick sync Tuesday to confirm assets. :thumbsup:
